WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT sc.zoneref, s.insurstat, COUNT(*) AS conservation_records
  FROM scanconservation AS sc
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
  GROUP BY sc.zoneref, s.insurstat
), ranked AS (
  SELECT zoneref, insurstat, conservation_records,
         1.0 * conservation_records / SUM(conservation_records) OVER () AS fraction,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY 1.0 * conservation_records / SUM(conservation_records) OVER () DESC) AS fraction_rank
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT zoneref, insurstat, conservation_records, fraction
FROM ranked
WHERE fraction_rank <= 10
ORDER BY fraction DESC, insurstat IS NULL ASC, zoneref;
